subject.title: [Bug]: web_search (kimi) returns 401 Invalid Authentication despite valid API key

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96721's docs and 401 diagnostic mitigation be considered sufficient to close this Kimi 401 report, or should the Moonshot plugin runtime/setup behavior change?
rationale: Current main already supports native `.cn` inheritance, but the report only proves a valid `.cn` key and not the full OpenClaw config or failing host; the open PR deliberately preserves the security guard around non-native endpoints.

options.title: Review linked mitigation
options.body: Treat the open PR as the canonical path and decide during review whether its docs and diagnostics close this issue.

options.title: Require exact repro first
options.body: Ask for redacted full config and failing request-host proof before accepting any close or fix direction.

options.title: Choose runtime behavior change
options.body: Direct a new or revised PR to change baseUrl inheritance/setup behavior if maintainers want bare Kimi webSearch keys to infer region differently.

recommendation.title: Review linked mitigation
recommendation.body: Treat the open PR as the canonical path and decide during review whether its docs and diagnostics close this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the prior Kimi web-search fixes and is the strongest routing owner for whether the current docs/diagnostic mitigation should close the report.
